#' Calculate OPERA predictions from a file
#'
#' @md
#' @description
#' `r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`
#' @param format format
#' @param standardize standardize
#' @param body Request body.
#' @return Decoded JSON or text, raw binary bytes, or NULL for an empty response.
#' @apiStage public
#' @export
# Generated with specmill; do not edit by hand.
chemi_opera_file <- function(format = "json", standardize = FALSE, body) {
  .api_validation$parameter_values(base::list("format" = format, "standardize" = standardize), list(format = list(default = "json", type = "string"), standardize = list(default = FALSE, type = "boolean")), .api_validation$body_value, c(format = "query", standardize = "query"))
  if (base::missing(body)) base::stop("Required body")
  if (!base::missing(body)) {
    body <- .api_validation$form_value(body, list(properties = list(file = list(description = "File to predict", format = "binary", type = "string")), required = list("file"), type = "object"), .api_validation$body_value, FALSE)
  }
  params <- base::list("format" = format, "standardize" = standardize, "body" = body)
  if (base::is.character(params[["format"]]) && base::any(!base::nzchar(params[["format"]]))) base::stop("Empty query parameter: format")
  if (base::is.character(params[["standardize"]]) && base::any(!base::nzchar(params[["standardize"]]))) base::stop("Empty query parameter: standardize")
  result <- .ct_request(method = "POST", path = "/api/opera/file", path_params = base::list(), query = base::list("format" = params[["format"]], "standardize" = params[["standardize"]]), body = params[["body"]], request_controls = list(preserve_errors = TRUE), server = list(diagnostic = "Relative server URL requires a recorded origin or explicit base URL override"), server_resolver = list(name = ".ct_server_url", key = "chemi_burl", relative = ""), body_media = "multipart/form-data", body_encoding = list(), form_schema = list(properties = list(file = list(description = "File to predict", format = "binary", type = "string")), required = list("file"), type = "object"))
  result
}
